title: xylophacos casei
intro: Xylophacos casei, commonly known as Yerba Santa, is a plant native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico, traditionally used by Native American tribes for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Xylophacos casei include its ability to reduce inflammation, relieve respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant effects, making it useful in treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of Xylophacos casei include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
